trades.reasoning: Full four-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) justifies deploying idle cash even on a neutral macro day.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ -0.2% and S&P 500 +0.2%, a neutral, directionless session. Rather than forcing capital into the market broadly, we bought KRMN, the one candidate showing all four confirming technical signals (momentum, trend, and volume), and left two slots open for stronger setups.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow range today, with the NASDAQ dipping slightly while the S&P 500 edged higher, reflecting a lack of strong directional conviction among investors. No major macro catalysts drove the session, so trading largely reflected stock-specific moves rather than broad market sentiment. This kind of mixed, low-volatility action is typical of consolidation phases between larger trends.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢窄幅震盪，納斯達克指數微跌0.2%，標普500指數則小升0.2%，顯示市場缺乏明確方向。由於今日並無重大總經消息帶動，盤面表現主要反映個股層面的資金流動，而非全面性的市場情緒。這種漲跌互見、波動較低的走勢，通常出現在大趨勢之間的整理階段。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade idea when several independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, price trend, and volume — all point the same direction at once. Relying on a single signal can lead to false starts, but when momentum, trend, and volume all align, it suggests real buying interest rather than noise.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有當多項獨立指標（如RSI、MACD、價格趨勢及成交量）同時指向同一方向時，才採取交易行動。僅依賴單一訊號容易誤判，但當動能、趨勢與成交量三者一致時，則更能反映真實的買盤力道，而非單純的雜訊波動。
